system: Luxus's VR cycle on spot gold (H4 and H1 bullish, a Level, the M5 VR and CF, zone-of-the-break entry, target the H1 impulsion 50%; then the buy at the 50%), OANDA M5

T1.rule: sell at the zone of the break of an M5 VR at a Level, H4 and H1 bullish, target the H1 impulsion 50%

T2.rule: buy at the zone of the break of an M5 VR at the 50% retracement, H4 and H1 still bullish, target the impulsion high

candidates.rule: T1: sell at the zone of the break of an M5 VR at a Level, H4 and H1 bullish, target the H1 impulsion 50%
T2: buy at the zone of the break of an M5 VR at the 50% retracement, H4 and H1 still bullish, target the impulsion high
T3: tests 1 and 2 as one stream
